title: Prologue · Onesa and Taifafeki join GDHCN and establish trust
description: Onesa and Taifafeki each join the WHO Global Digital Health Certification Network. Each onboards its Public Key Infrastructure: a Country Signing Certificate Authority and the Document Signer Certificates it issues. Officer Noa submits Onesa's public keys to the GDHCN; WHO, as Trust Network Anchor, verifies them and adds them to the trust list. Officer Lio's Taifafeki downloads that trust list, so it now trusts Onesa's keys, and Onesa trusts Taifafeki's.

steps.title: Onesa and Taifafeki join GDHCN and establish trust
steps.headline: Both countries join the GDHCN: Onesa's public keys reach the trust list, and Taifafeki downloads it.
steps.narrative: Onesa and Taifafeki each join the WHO Global Digital Health Certification Network. Each onboards its Public Key Infrastructure: a Country Signing Certificate Authority and the Document Signer Certificates it issues. Officer Noa submits Onesa's public keys to the GDHCN; WHO, as Trust Network Anchor, verifies them and adds them to the trust list. Officer Lio's Taifafeki downloads that trust list, so it now trusts Onesa's keys, and Onesa trusts Taifafeki's.

experiences.doing: Submits Onesa's public key certificates to the GDHCN through the Trust Network Gateway.
Downloads the GDHCN trust list into Taifafeki's verification PKI.
Issues Document Signer Certificates under Onesa's Country Signing CA.
Verifies the submitted keys and distributes them in the trust list.
Keeps a current copy of the trust list for Taifafeki's health systems.

steps.painPoint: Without a shared trust list, every pair of countries would have to exchange and maintain each other's keys.
steps.enabler: One onboarding to the GDHCN makes a country's keys verifiable by every participant.
